{{NPC Infobox |image = NPC Yingda.png |type = Open-World |nation = Huanglong |location = Huanglong |group = |affiliation = |title = |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} '''Yingda''' is an NPC in [[Huanglong]]. Yingda is the Captain of Chenbi and Shuhe. ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(During the day) :'''Yingda:''' Hello, to schedule a meeting with the Jinzhou Magistrate, please submit the necessary paperwork. :{{DIcon}} Someone has already completed the procedures for me. :'''Yingda:''' OK, in that case, just produce it when you are at the meeting. :{{DIcon}} Why have you been staring over there? :'''Yingda:''' Hmm... It's part of my duties as a City Hall guard. :'''Yingda:''' But there might be other reasons. The two guards over there, [[Chenbi]] and [[Shuhe]]. I'm their leaders. :{{DIcon}} Why don't you trust Chenbi? ::'''Yingda:''' Since her father died in the war, she's always wanted to complete her father's unfinished business. ::'''Yingda:''' That's why she signed up to be a City Hall guard. If not shining as a [[Midnight Rangers|Midnight Ranger]], she's finding other ways to make a mark. ::'''Yingda:''' But you know, they're young, and already a few days on guard duty has them so stressed. I do find it concerning. :{{DIcon}} Why don't you trust Shuhe? ::'''Yingda:''' Him? That kid's got all the strength in the world. ::'''Yingda:''' It's just that sometimes, once she decides on something, she will never change her mind. She's straightforward and a bit stubborn... ---- ;(During the evening) :'''Yingda:''' City Hall is the heart of Jinzhou. :'''Yingda:''' I need to give everything I have for the event happening today. :'''Yingda:''' I hope they grow competent enough soon... {{Dialogue End}} ==Trivia== *At night around 18:00, [[Yingda]] calls over [[Shuhe]] and [[Chenbi]] from their post to talk. The two will return to their post at 21:00. {{Description|Yingda: The number of applications for meetings at City Hall is on the rise.
Yingda:I'm not sure if Chenbi and Shuhe are up for this challenge...
Yingda: Chenbi, Shuhe, come here.
Chenbi: Captain...
Yingda: Anything unusual?
Shuhe: Not really.
Shuhe: But those rejected by Lady Sanhua just won't leave.
Chenbi: Maybe they really have important causes...
Chenbi: But no matter what, our first duty is to do our jobs well.
Yingda: Very well, our main goal is to maintain order in City Hall, no matter the circumstances.
Yingda: Please report any issues immediately.}} ==Note== *There is a translation error where he misgenders Shuhe. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Yingda |zhs = 英达 |zht = 英達 |ja = 英達（エイタツ） |ko = 영달 |es = Yingda |fr = Yingda |de = Yingda }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.0}}
